latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of texture-art-generator.

- Generate hyperrealistic macro images of materials like glass, crystal, jelly, wax, soap, and more.
- Ideal for ASMR creators, product backgrounds, and social media content.
- Uses the Neta AI image generation API (requires free trial token).
- Supports prompt input, size options, and style inheritance via reference images.
